Use case: ui-mockup. Produce one polished, high fidelity desktop SaaS UI screenshot, 16:10 landscape, preferably 2400x1500, flat front-on full canvas with no browser chrome, no device frame, no perspective, no presentation annotations. Brand wordmark "lycoboai". Audience Chinese home textile crossborder ecommerce operators. ALL interface copy is crisp legible Simplified Chinese in PingFang/system sans. HeroUI v3 visual language: compact restrained product controls, understated thin neutral borders, no decorative glows, no giant round pills, no dot grid. Pixel-role target: page #0F0F12, panels #17171B, inputs #121216, elevated modal #24242B, secondary surfaces #202026, text #F3F1F7, muted #AAA7B2. Purple accent #8B5CF6; strongest CTA vertical gradient from #BAA4FF top to #8B5CF6 bottom with almost-black #09070D text. Accent only selected states and primary actions. Radius buttons and images8px inputs10 cards12 modal16. Base UI text14px at1440 equivalent; title24. Professional daily-operation tool, image-led, quiet and precise. Consistent compact global sidebar about180px with logo then 首页, 图片创作 (selected pale purple background and lavender text), 案例库, 素材库, 历史记录; bottom 帮助中心. Topbar about64px with breadcrumb left and 任务中心, subtle bell and avatar right, no fake credits or users or notification badges. Photorealistic home textile examples: a cream ivory diamond-quilted comforter and exactly TWO matching pillow shams, three-piece set, no bedsheets shown as a separate product, no extra cushions. Bedroom uses warm oak low bed, soft daylight, plaster wall. No marketing hero, no tech/debug/preview labels inside UI. This is an illustrative UI design, not evidence of working services.
SCREEN: TOOL SELECTION MODAL open above a subdued dimmed workspace. Entire sidebar and topbar visible beneath black translucent backdrop. Modal centered in available content with generous 48-70px breathing room at sides, around1120px wide in1440px frame, not fullscreen, all content visible without clipping. Modal title "图片创作", subtitle "从一套商品图，开始新的创作"; clear close X top right. Tabs "家纺生图" selected, "换色换花型", "图文合成"; one restrained search field "搜索工具". Below six tool cards arranged 3 columns x2 rows with generous image sizes and compact textfooters. Each card uses a distinct real photoreal product result, no generic vector illustration.
1 "图生图" description "上传商品图，用一句话描述修改需求" hero thumbnail cream quilt bedroom, tiny subtle "常用" badge; selected border lavender and explicit small gradient action "进入工具".
2 "卧室场景图" desc "保留商品细节，替换卧室与拍摄场景" same ivory comforter2pillows in sunny oak bedroom.
3 "被子换色" desc "保持绗缝与质感，生成更多配色" show elegant cream/lavender/sage bedding variants in one neat triptych.
4 "替换花型" desc "参考花型图，替换被面与枕套图案" image sage small floral comforter two shams.
5 "套件组合图" desc "清楚呈现一条被子与两个枕套" clean whiteground arranged one folded creamquilt two separatematching shams.
6 "卖点图文" desc "把面料、工艺与套件信息排成商品图" editorial image with closeup seam and tasteful on-image short English "SOFT & LIGHT".
All six cards same height, card12radius images8radius, each title single line. Bottom simple small text "选择工具后进入创作，当前草稿会保留" no big secondary CTA. No generation forms inside modal, no giant banners. Make images about60percent of modalcontent.

They show same singlecreamivory diamond-quiltedcomforter with exactly2matchingshams, first front3quarter bed view, second different slightlycloserwide bedroom angle, tasteful warmoak lowbed, windowlight, naturaltexture. Under each image neutral inline actions "下载" "收藏" "再次创作". Do not create a fourpart collage as a single output. Below these resulttiles show just top portion of previous task "浅紫配色 · 同款绗缝" with slender lavenderbeddingthumbnail, to make vertical history context apparent, not extra big dashboard cards.
RIGHT separate narrow subtleborder rail header "历史". 5 small square bedding task thumbnails vertically spaced, first active thinpurpleborder, other lavender, sage,whitepackshot,oldbedroom; optional bottom chevron. Rail purely navigation. Wholeframe should be about27percent controls and60percent image/resultspace (excluding globalsidebar). No timeline or videos or empty giant blank canvas.
